limitations.quote: Keep the final 0 as a prefix across invalid cycles
limitations.note: The patch fixed the one-cycle match delay but also changed the match state's exits for a valid 1 and an invalid cycle, allowing overlapping detections where the reference returns to idle.
The exhaustive test used a sliding window that expected overlapping matches, so it validated the new behavior instead of catching the regression in the original match-state transitions.
The first two edit attempts failed to match the source and made no changes, so the edit had to be redone with line-based substitutions.
